title: Akiyama Mizuki — Putting A Name To The Face〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Putting A Name To The Face（2★）

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's already this late...
Time sure flies when you're on this video site.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's not quite 25:00 yet, but I should probably log on now before I forget.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, K. Oh, Enanan, you're already here too. What's up?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Perfect timing.
K has something she needs to ask you, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So, Amia, would you be interested in going to a bridal fair...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's a fairly big one with a dress exhibit, a wide variety of accessory shops and other related booths...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, are you talking about the Phoenix Bridal Fair?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Of course! I've actually been meaning to check it out♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I wanna see all the dresses they have on display, and there's even supposed to be hands-on activities!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Really? Then, I'm glad I decided to ask you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The thing is, my housekeeper—Ms. Mochizuki—she received a ticket and invited me to go.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, Honami Mochizuki? Everything she cooks is supposed to be absolutely delicious, right?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. As it turns out, her ticket allows admission for one more person...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So, Amia, would you like to go with us?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, wait... You already know her, don't you, Enanan? Shouldn't you go instead?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Why? You should go since you're actually interested in going.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Also, I can't since I have art class that day. Take up the offer and go have some fun.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You sure? Then, I might just have to accept...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait a second... This means I finally get to meet Mochizuki, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, don't go messing with her or putting any weird ideas in her head!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I won't! Geez, who do you think I am?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I really just wanna see what she's like. I mean, the rest of you have all met her already.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, that's right. She's Yuki's junior, huh...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <See what I mean? So, I'm super excited to meet her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Actually, what is she like?
All I know is that she's a first-year at Miya Girls and is in a band...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Well, she's kind, humble and has a strong sense of responsibility.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, not many people are that easy to get along with.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, she's super nice, plays music and knows how to cook and clean?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That's pretty amazing.
Is there anything this girl isn't good at?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Anything she's not good at...? Until recently, she seemed to be bothered by her unique art style...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, I almost forgot! You taught her how to draw, right, Enanan?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, it's a little hard to tell what she's drawing sometimes, but she definitely has her own distinct touch!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Anyway, there's no question that she's a great person. Why not just wait to see for yourself when you actually meet and talk to her?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <K, I'll be looking forward to the fair♪>
